note: Five interleaved pairs on one host. The same partitionline runtime fetched from two null brokers: the parent concatenates cached batches and then copies them into the Fetch response; the candidate writes each cached batch into the response once. Every run verified 20,000 records and validation_failures stayed 0. Client allocation count stayed 135,370. The paired mean records/s ratio is 1.076 and the bootstrap 95% CI is 1.043 to 1.114. This is a null-broker copy change, not a client-code speedup, not a fetch comparison against other clients, and not a fastest-client result.
